Package library

Class MediaLoan

java.lang.Object
library.MediaLoan
public class MediaLoan extends Object
Represents a polymorphic loan for different types of media, supporting both Book and CD.

This class was introduced in Sprint 5 to generalize the loan model so that a single object can represent a loan of either type of media.

Loan Duration Rules:

  • Book: 28 days
  • CD: 7 days

Return state and overdue calculations are included to support higher-level operations such as penalties and reminders.

  • Constructor Details

    • MediaLoan

      public MediaLoan(Object media, LocalDate borrowDate)
      Creates a new media loan.

      The due date depends on the type of media:

      • Book: borrow date + 28 days
      • CD: borrow date + 7 days
      Parameters:
      media - the borrowed media item (Book or CD)
      borrowDate - the date the media was borrowed
